title: I love my little park slope theatre so so so much & thanks @Logan Kel...
transcript: I see a lot of theater and I live in Brooklyn which means I spend a lot of time on trains committing into Manhattan but today I'm staying in Brooklyn and I'm going to one of the theaters that is walking distance from my house so I'm seeing the Gallery Players production of something rotten! I've been to the Gallery Players once before to see once which was so good and it's like a beautiful day out so I'm so excited to walk to and from the theater here we are I know I saw this on Broadway but I actually don't remember anything about it I'm at the literal first show but you can come until May 18th it's actually like a pretty decent stage size the gallery players theatre that was so much fun I had such a good time truly just like the perfect show for theater people if you’re in New York it’s running for the next three weekends at the Gallery Players Theater and just uh go support your local theater guys
